text:
maria: Quick follow-up from the KV leak postmortem — I updated the PM action registry but need clear owners for the remaining items. Can folks volunteer? :eyes:
raj: I can take profiling exports + flamegraphs for shard hot paths. ETA EOW.
anya: I'll run coordinated heapshots across prod-canary and staging tomorrow AM, capture fragmentation histo.
leo: I'll own GC/eviction tuning experiments. Need the test harness from @maria.
maria: Thanks — @leo I'll drop the harness link here in a sec.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: perf-harness/2026-03-22T18:12Z
maria: Link: https://internal.redwood/perf/harness/kv-residency-experiments (note: run with --kv-alloc-logs)
raj: Taking note. For flamegraphs run: `./profiler --target=kv-service --duration=5m --out=flame.svg`
anya: Observed fragmentation spikes when sequence length > 1024 yesterday. Will attach snapshots.
leo: Proposed guardrail: softlimit eviction at 85% residency + OOM alert early-warning (10% headroom) — thoughts?
raj: +1 on softlimit. Need to ensure no perf cliffs; will run load tests.
maria: Action items (quick): 1) raj -> perf exports + flamegraphs (due 2026-03-26) 2) anya -> heapshots + frag histos (due 2026-03-24) 3) leo -> eviction/GC tuning experiments (due 2026-03-28). I'll add to the PM board and ping owners in the doc. :white_check_mark:
anya: adding note: include `--kv-prefix-cache` toggles in experiments to validate prefix cache hit impact.
maria: Also, recurring pattern: leaks spike on version rollouts with model change X — we should gate rollouts with canary residency thresholds.
raj: I'll add a small regression test to the rollout job: fail canary if avg residency > 75% for 5m.
leo: Will prototype eviction policy change in a branch and post PR.
maria: Thanks all — syncing again Friday standup. If anyone needs ownership swapped ping me.
